description: LASSO—Locating and Selecting Scenarios Online is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. The LASSO tool guides you step-by-step through the process of identifying and downloading climate change scenarios (or projections) that are relevant to your interest or research question. At each step you will define criteria that will subset climate change information from a much larger archive, with LASSO providing helpful information and suggestions along the way. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
